archetypes.name: fix-completeness
archetypes.rationale: The plan names plan_review_round.py as possibly affected but the diff only modifies plan_review.py; need to verify no 0-accepted exit paths were missed.
archetypes.prompt_body: The plan identifies plan_review_round.py as a possible source of the 0-accepted terminal round bug, but the diff only modifies plan_review.py. Read plan_review_round.py in full and check whether it contains any plan-review loop-exit paths (phase transitions, early returns, or loop breaks) that can leave a round in a 0-accepted terminal state without calling _write_design_round_meta. Also verify whether the three new call sites in plan_review.py (_run_apply accepted==0 early exit, _run_apply empty-findings early exit, run_step3_review ACCEPTED_COUNT==0 path) are mutually exclusive for any given round, or whether more than one can fire for the same round_num and cause a double write; confirm the write-design-round-meta CLI verb is idempotent under double invocation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: silent-meta-failure
archetypes.rationale: _write_design_round_meta discards _run_command return values; a silent CLI failure leaves round-meta.json absent and the original mismatch bug silently recurring.
archetypes.prompt_body: The new _write_design_round_meta function calls _run_command and assigns the result to _ (discard), swallowing any non-zero exit from the write-design-round-meta CLI. If that command fails (missing round dir, permissions error, or CLI crash), round-meta.json is never written and the original header-vs-table mismatch bug recurs silently with no log and no error propagated to the caller. Compare with how other _run_command calls in plan_review.py treat non-zero return codes. Also check the override branch: when WRITE_DESIGN_ROUND_META_SH is set but the file is not executable (Path.exists() passes, os.access fails), the function silently skips both the override and the production path with no fallback; assess whether this silent no-op is intentional or a gap. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
